items.title: 8.3.1 Online Libraries and Research Databases (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.3.1 (PDF 199-200), with MCQs 5 and 6 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Aaj ke digital daur mein bohat si libraries aur research databases (tehqeeqi maloomat ke zakheere) online maujood hain, jo bohat sa academic (ilmi) mawad dete hain. Yeh digital tools aap ko research projects ke liye reliable aur scholarly (mahireen ki) maloomat dhoondne mein madad dete hain.

Academic journals mukhtalif shobon (fields) ke experts ke likhe articles ka majmooa hote hain. Yeh articles aam taur par peer-reviewed hote hain, yani chhapne se pehle doosre experts unhein check karte hain; is liye yeh bharose ke qabil sources hain. Student ke taur par aap school library, university portal ya open-access websites (jahan mawad muft parha ja sake) ke zariye bohat se journals online parh sakte hain.

Misal: agar aap pollution (aaloodgi) ka maqami ecosystems (jandaron aur un ke mahol ka nizam) par asar research kar rahe hain, to environmental science ki studies chhapne wale academic journals dhoondein. Pakistan ki bohat si universities online libraries ki suhulat deti hain jahan aise journals milte hain. Is ke ilawa Google Scholar aur ResearchGate jaisi websites kuch academic papers muft parhne deti hain.

blocks.prompt: Article ke “peer-reviewed” hone ka kya matlab hai? (MCQ 5)  Online libraries ka aham maqsad kya hai? (MCQ 6)
blocks.explanation: MCQ 5: (c) It is reviewed by other experts in the field; kitab ke mutabiq peer-reviewed article chhapne se pehle doosre experts check karte hain. MCQ 6: (b) Offering a variety of academic resources; kitab kehti hai online libraries aur databases bohat sa academic mawad dete hain. (Kitab ki answer key (b) aur (a) deti hai, jo text se mel nahi khate; yahan text wala jawab hai.)

items: Online libraries aur research databases bohat sa academic mawad dete hain.
Academic journals experts ke peer-reviewed articles hain; Google Scholar, ResearchGate kuch papers muft dete hain.
